description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Dark 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Dark 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Nabaat], [Malicious Surge Ability Tracker] and [Malicious Surge Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Dark 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Dark damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Nabaat
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Malicious Surge (0~2), removed after using Malicious Surge two times

description.name: Malicious Surge Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Malicious Surge level by 1 after using 7 Dark abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Nabaat]

description.name: Malicious Surge Level
description.text: Keeps track of Malicious Surge level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Nabaat]
